localRules.description: Minecraft Java game-window title rules for vanilla, Fast, Silent, Lunar, Badlion, Feather, TLauncher and Legacy Launcher. Native LWJGL, GLFW30 or SDL_app game surface required; launcher windows are excluded. Launcher-started games retaining a Minecraft title use the vanilla rule.
